window.title: Zhiyi IME Settings
app.name: Zhiyi IME
general.input_style_hint: While typing, the style switch key cycles full pinyin → initials → Wubi → shuangpin. Full pinyin also accepts initials and mixes (wsyige); in initials mode each letter is one character
general.layout_hint: Learning mode translations show only in the vertical layout
general.laya_enable: Recommend candidates and compose long input by context
general.laya_hint: A local model reads the text before the caret and puts the best candidate first, starred. When off, candidates follow frequency and learning, and less memory is used
general.device_hint: A graphics card is tested first; it takes about 300 MB of video memory and 220 MB of memory
general.device_testing: Testing the speed of this graphics card…
general.device_result: About {0} ms per recommendation on this graphics card, {1} ms on the CPU
general.device_none: No graphics card on this computer can run the recommendation model
general.device_slower: About {0} ms per recommendation on this graphics card, slower than the CPU ({1} ms); the CPU is recommended
general.device_failed: The recommendation model cannot run on this graphics card, so the CPU stays in use.
general.autostart_hint: When off, it starts the first time you switch to it; typing works a few seconds later
general.data_hint: User dictionary, learning records, language packs, model caches and downloaded models are kept here
general.data_pick: Choose a folder for the Zhiyi IME data
general.data_unavailable: The chosen location cannot be reached now (a drive not connected?); the default {0} is in use
general.data_bad_folder: This folder cannot be used: it is inside the current data, the Zhiyi IME program or the Windows folder. Please choose another folder.
general.data_not_writable: This folder cannot be written to. Please choose another folder.
general.data_existing:
{0} already holds Zhiyi IME data.

Yes: use the data there (the current data will be deleted)
No: replace it with the current data
Cancel: do not move
general.data_no_space: Not enough space on the target drive: about {0} MB is needed.
general.data_confirm_existing:
The data already in {0} will be used, and the data in {2} deleted.

The input method's background service closes and restarts.
general.data_server_busy: The background service did not close within 30 seconds; nothing was moved. Please try again later.
general.data_copy_failed: Copying the data failed; nothing was moved and the data stays where it was.
general.data_left: The data was moved, but {0} files in the old location are in use and could not be deleted. You can delete them after a restart.
general.english_correction_hint: Misspelled words get their correct spelling as a candidate; the first candidate stays what you typed
fuzzy.hint: Words with a similar sound are offered too, with their correct pinyin in parentheses, e.g. 中国(zhong guo)
keys.switch_hint: Tap Shift or Ctrl alone, or use a key combination
keys.style_hint: Chinese: full pinyin → initials → Wubi → shuangpin    English: words / letters
keys.capture_hint: Click a key box, then press the new key (Esc cancels). Right-click clears it (no shortcut). Any switch key can be Shift or Ctrl tapped alone, each for one switch.
keys.need_combo: Needs Ctrl/Alt + key, Shift + Space or F1-F11
privacy.experience: Join the user experience improvement program
privacy.what: Logs basic information such as versions, settings and errors. Nothing you type.
privacy.input_what: Also logs what you type, the text before the caret, usage statistics and the program in use. Needs the user experience improvement program.
privacy.local: Records stay on this computer and are never uploaded.
privacy.input_confirm:
Zhiyi IME will log what you type, the text before the caret (the context the recommendation model reads) and the program in use on this computer, and join the user experience improvement program. The records are never uploaded.

The Privacy page links to the details. Allow it?
privacy.delete_confirm: Delete all records of the user experience improvement program (basic information and input)?
update.notify: Tell me when a new version is available
update.notify_hint: Checks GitHub for a new version when Settings opens. Only the version information is downloaded; nothing is sent.
update.not_found: No release information on GitHub yet.
update.network_failed: Could not reach GitHub. Check the network and try again.
update.invalid: The release information failed verification; the update was stopped.
update.download_failed: The download failed. Check the network and try again.
update.verify_failed: The installer failed verification and was deleted. Try again.
update.disk_failed: Could not save the installer: disk full or no permission.
update.install_cancelled: Installation cancelled. Click "Update now" to try again.
update.updated: Updated to {0}. Programs already open use the new version after they are reopened.
keys.note_taken: Used by another program, may not work
keys.note_program: May clash with common program shortcuts
keys.restore_confirm:
Restore the 4 switch keys to the defaults:

Chinese/English: tap Shift
Style switch: Ctrl + Space
Punctuation: Ctrl + .
Full/half width: Shift + Space

The current keys are replaced when you click OK or Apply. Continue?
keys.invalid: Use F1-F11, Shift + Space, or Ctrl/Alt (optionally with Shift) with a letter, digit, common punctuation key or Space; common shortcuts such as copy and paste are not allowed.
keys.conflict: The switch key is the same as the global "switch to Zhiyi IME" shortcut. Please choose another key.
keys.page_hint: Pages candidates while they show; PageUp / PageDown always do. With comma, period or a bracket chosen, press Space first to type that mark after pinyin.
dictionary.learning_hint: Words you pick often move up and new words are remembered; in English, the corrections you pick and the words you keep as typed
dictionary.clear_confirm:
Clear all learning data?

The learned candidate order and remembered words will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
dictionary.clear_failed: Could not clear the learning data. Make sure the IME is running and try again.
backup.hint: Export all settings, the lexicon and learning records to one file; import it after moving or reinstalling. Imported settings replace these and words are merged; an incomplete or damaged backup imports nothing. The file holds words you typed: keep it safe.
backup.pick_folder: Choose a folder to export to
backup.apply_first:
There are changes not applied yet. Apply them before exporting?

No exports the saved settings.
backup.export_failed: The export failed. Check that the folder can be written to and try again.
backup.backup_first:
Back up the current settings, lexicon and learning records first?

Yes exports a backup to a folder you choose, to restore the settings from if needed.
backup.import_invalid: The backup is damaged or not a backup. Nothing was imported.
backup.import_missing: The backup is incomplete. Nothing was imported.
backup.import_hotkey: A shortcut in the backup is used by another program. Nothing was imported.
backup.import_failed: The import failed. Nothing was imported.
backup.packs_missing:
The backup shows candidate translations, but these language packs are not on this computer: {packs}.

Go to the Learning page to download them?
wordlists.hint: Words of a dictionary imported here show among the candidates and take part in sentences; a pinyin dictionary also types with shuangpin, initials and Wubi. Supported: Sogou cell dictionaries (.scel), Rime dictionaries (.dict.yaml), pinyin text exports (from Sogou or QQ) and English word lists (a word per line). Imported words rank after the common words of the system dictionary and move up once picked twice. Checking or unchecking a list takes effect at once, without Apply.
wordlists.detail_zh: Chinese · {added} new words ({existing} already in the dictionary, left out) · {wubi} with Wubi · imported {time}
wordlists.detail_en: English · {added} new words ({existing} already in the dictionary, left out) · imported {time}
wordlists.remove_confirm:
Remove the word list "{name}"?

Its words go, and so does what was learned of picking them. This cannot be undone. To stop using it for a while, uncheck it instead.
wordlists.filter_text: Text: pinyin dictionaries or English word lists (*.txt; *.csv; *.tsv)
wordlists.error_extension:
This kind of file is not supported.

Files that can be imported: .scel (Sogou cell dictionary), .dict.yaml (Rime dictionary), .txt / .csv / .tsv (a pinyin dictionary or an English word list).
wordlists.error_duplicate: This file is imported already (word list "{name}").
wordlists.error_too_many_zh: At most {count} Chinese word lists can be imported. Remove one you do not use first.
wordlists.error_too_many_en: At most {count} English word lists can be imported. Remove one you do not use first.
wordlists.error_storage: The list of word lists (wordlists\index.json in the data folder) is damaged and could not be made again from the word list files, so the word lists cannot be changed now.
wordlists.preview_zh: Of the new words, {pinyin} type with pinyin and {wubi} with Wubi.
wordlists.preview_guessed: The pinyin of {guessed} words was worked out from their characters and may be wrong for characters with several readings; the list shows them after the import.
wordlists.preview_en: The words complete as you type in English mode.
wordlists.guessed_intro: The pinyin of these words of "{name}" was worked out from their characters (the most common reading of each):
wordlists.guessed_more: {count} in all; only the first are listed.
wordlists.error_format:
This file is not a supported dictionary.

Supported: Sogou cell dictionaries (.scel), Rime dictionaries (.dict.yaml), pinyin text exports and English word lists (a word per line).
wordlists.error_no_words: No word to import was found in the file.
wordlists.error_no_pinyin:
This is a list of Chinese words without pinyin, which cannot be imported yet.

Use a format with pinyin, such as a Sogou or QQ export, or convert it to a Rime dictionary first (for example with imewlconverter).
wordlists.error_too_large: The file is larger than 64 MB and cannot be imported.
wordlists.error_nothing_new: The system dictionary has every word of this dictionary already: nothing to import.
wordlists.error_load: The imported word lists cannot be read now. Try again later.
wordlists.error_change: The word list could not be changed. Try again later.
error.server_unavailable: The background service did not start, so this could not be done. Try again in a moment.
about.tagline: Lightweight, open-source, context-aware Chinese and English input method
learning.hint: The candidate window becomes vertical. Download a gray language's pack below first.
learning.digits_translation: Number keys type the translation (Ctrl+number types the candidate)
learning.keys_hint: Ctrl+1–9 (1–9 with the option below) types a candidate's translation, if it has one.
learning.failed_network: Can't reach GitHub. Check the network and try again
learning.failed_disk: Can't save the pack: not enough space or no permission
learning.not_found: This pack isn't on the server yet
learning.remove_confirm:
Remove the {0} language pack?

You can download it again later.
learning.remove_failed: Couldn't remove the pack while it's in use. Try again later.
learning.translator_enable: Translate words, phrases and short sentences the language pack lacks with a model on this computer
learning.translator_missing: Translation model · not downloaded · about 0.4 GB
learning.translator_hint: Runs on a graphics card or the CPU (about 0.3 s a page on the CPU, faster on a card) in about 1 GB of memory, offline. Translations follow the candidates; it unloads after a minute unused
learning.translator_speed: This graphics card translates a page in about {0} ms; the CPU in about {1} ms
learning.translator_slower: This graphics card translates a page in about {0} ms, slower than the CPU (about {1} ms): the CPU is the better choice
learning.translator_needs_app: This translation model needs Zhiyi IME {0} or later. Please update the input method first
learning.translator_remove_confirm: Delete the downloaded translation model? You can download it again later.
learning.translator_remove_later: Some files are in use; they are deleted the next time Settings opens
learning.translator_card_failed: The translation model cannot run on the chosen graphics card or CPU, so offline translation was turned off. You can try another one.
error.save: The IME service could not save and apply the configuration.
error.save_timeout: The IME service is busy and did not answer in time. The settings may have been saved; reopen Settings in a moment to check.
error.save_rejected: The IME service did not take these settings. Save again; if it keeps failing, installation files may be missing or damaged, and reinstalling Zhiyi IME repairs them.
error.save_details: The reason is in the log problems.log (Collect Diagnostics includes it):
error.hotkey_taken: The global shortcut is used by another program. The configuration was not saved.
keys.voice_hint: Press once to start speaking and again to finish (or click stop on the voice bar at the bottom of the screen). Turn it on on the Voice input page first.
voice.usage: Press the shortcut and speak: a voice bar appears at the bottom of the screen, its waves moving while you speak. Press the shortcut again or click stop to finish; typing pauses until the text is in. The text is underlined: Backspace or Esc deletes it, Enter keeps it, and typing on keeps it too.
voice.missing: Voice model · not downloaded · about 240 MB
voice.model_hint: SenseVoice-Small (FunAudioLLM): Mandarin, English, Cantonese and Chinese mixed with English; other dialects not yet. Recognized on this computer; recordings are not kept or sent anywhere.
voice.device_hint: A sentence takes about 0.1 s on the CPU, so a graphics card is seldom needed; one (DirectML) takes the work off the CPU.
voice.itn: Numbers and dates as digits (“3点”, “10月15号”)
voice.remove_confirm: Remove the voice model? Voice input is turned off; you can download it again at any time.
voice.needs_app: This voice model needs Zhiyi IME {0} or later
voice.failed_disk: Can't save the voice model: not enough space or no permission
